ACT 516 

 

THE FIVE HUNDRED AND SIXTEENTH 

ACT 

OF THE PARLIAMENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF GHANA 

ENTITLED 

THE STATUTE LAW REVISION ACT, 1996 

AN ACT to repeal certain statutes that are no longer applicable or have become spent. 

DATE OF ASSENT: 8TH AUGUST, 1996 

BE IT ENACTED by Parliament as follows— 

Section 1—Enactments Repealed. 

The enactments specified in the Schedule to this Act are repealed.
